steps.text: BUG-31a / J5: a scene change through SceneTransit (the path every RunManager load takes, RUN-SAFE): the booth's shutter comes down, the scene and the office's gameplay layer load behind it, the light moves through the slats meanwhile, the shutter goes up. Analyse seq/office_title and seq/title_office with seqtools frozen (<= 0.25 s) and cuts (none): each is the load alone (flowRecLoad, FLOW round 7), from the load's frame to the shutter off, so the settled scene after the shutter, which may hold still, is not in it. Round 5, S4: then the queue in play (flowQueue): the Title asked for, the office asked for while the shutter comes down (it replaces the Title before any load), the Title asked for again while the shutter rises over the office (it comes down again); the Title must end up loaded, the change over and the veil off, the marks in start/rise/up order
